title: Screen profiles for automated screenshot capture
description: One rendering surface per profile. Shared by every LumbreCode stack so a Flutter integration test and a Playwright spec produce comparable images that documentation can reference by the same name.

name.description: Directory name under design/screenshots/. Stable: documentation references it.

width.description: Logical pixels. Capture uses a device pixel ratio of 1 so the image is 1:1.

primary.description: The profile documentation uses when a page references a screenshot without naming one. Exactly one profile should set it.
